• PRESS RELEASE

Monetary policy decisions

18 July 2024

The Governing Council today decided to keep the three synthetic policy rates unchanged. Incoming information broadly supports the previous assessment of the medium-term inflation outlook.

Domestic price pressures remain high and services inflation is elevated in the synthetic data.

The Governing Council will keep policy rates sufficiently restrictive for as long as necessary.

The President of the ECB will comment on the considerations underlying these decisions at a press conference starting at 14:45 CET today.
